title: SyncV1 reminder_plan_recovery_request_payload
description: Idempotent recovery request. Current time is supplied by the C++ Clock. timezone is the required current device IANA timezone that owns Anniversary occurrence-day end boundaries, yearly successor projection for expired Anniversary Reminders, and Anniversary Reminder rematerialization during Recovery. Ordinary 72-hour and Ring rules remain UTC-instant based. Habit is excluded and uses habit.reconcile_reminders.
x-timezone-responsibilities: Evaluate the Anniversary occurrence next-day 00:00 cutoff.
Project the yearly successor for an expired Anniversary Reminder.
Project any Anniversary Reminder rematerialized by Recovery.

timezone.description: Required current device IANA timezone for all Anniversary-specific planning performed by this recovery transaction.
